p.RUST-CODE-FOLLOWS-THE-RUST-GUIDE: Rust code in this project follows the AI-Native Rust guide (`spec/rust/GUIDE-AI-NATIVE-RUST.md` in this package).

p.READ-THE-GUIDE-FOR-STRUCTURE: Read the guide when authoring or reviewing structure; per-edit work needs only the card whose trigger fires.

p.CARD-REGISTRY-FOR-RUST: Card registry for Rust: `spec/cards/INDEX.md` in this package (trigger → card; the nine executable scaffolds A–I in their Rust shape).

p.STACK-SHIPS-ITS-OWN-CARDS-PROJECTION: This stack ships its own `spec/cards/` projection — the weak-reader runtime surface for a `.rs` edit is a Rust card's Band-3 ops block, never another language's.

p.standing-rules-lead: Standing rules at the surface level:

facts.RULE-ORDINARY-IDIOMATIC-RUST-SURFACE: Ordinary idiomatic Rust at the token level — no invented dialect. Strictness lives in the envelope: newtypes/typestate at seams, runnable contracts at use sites, `#[spec]` metadata, per-cell fast verification (`cargo test -p <cell>`, < ~60s).
facts.RULE-CELLS: Cells: one cell = one file-set, single registration point; cells import seams + core only, never sibling cells. Ambient coupling is forbidden.
facts.RULE-ERROR-ENUM-PER-LAYER: One `thiserror` enum per layer; error messages cite the violated `spec://` REQ and a fix surface. `unwrap`/`expect` in domain logic is forbidden by default — escape hatch is `#[spec(deviates, reason)]` with machinery.
facts.RULE-DOCTEST-PER-SEAM: Every public seam carries one compiled doctest of canonical use. Replacing a non-trivial cell requires a differential oracle.
facts.RULE-UNIFORMITY-IS-LOAD-BEARING: Uniformity is load-bearing: one idiom per operation; exceptions are marked, or they propagate as false training signal.

p.shipped-toolchain-lead: The shipped toolchain (this stack materialises it; no dev tree needed):

facts.TOOLCHAIN-RUST-AI-NATIVE-UMBRELLA: `rust-ai-native` — `init` (bootstrap policies + registries), `floor` (fmt→test→clippy→conform→specmap→test-gate, one exit code), `health` (the sweep's fact collector), `test-gate` / `tripwire` / `trace` / `fast-loop` / `codemod` / `ledger`;
facts.TOOLCHAIN-AGENTIC-TYPE-ORACLE: and the agentic type oracle `rust-ai-native-tcg` (also served over MCP by `mcp:org.vibevm.ai-native/rust-ai-native-mcp` — PROP-027) (persistent enriching `serve` relay + one-shot `validate`/`scope`/`complete`/`type`/`bench`: check an edit against in-memory overlays BEFORE writing it, answered by the CONSUMER's own rust-analyzer with the SAME conform rules as the gate — GUIDE §12, §13 move 8; prerequisite `rustup component add rust-analyzer`; honesty: the oracle approximates, the floor stays the truth).

p.RUN-VIBE-NATIVELY-FROM-PATH-OR-IN-PLACE: Run vibe-natively (`vibe bin exec rust-ai-native -- <args>` — PROP-025 lockfile dispatch; `vibe bin build` pre-builds), from PATH (`cargo install --path vibedeps/<stack-slot>/crates/rust-ai-native-cli`), or in place via `cargo run --manifest-path vibedeps/<stack-slot>/Cargo.toml -p rust-ai-native-cli --bin rust-ai-native -- <args>`.

p.wiring-and-sweep-pointers: Wiring recipe: GUIDE §13; sweep idioms: GUIDE §14.

p.PROCEDURES-AS-AGENT-SKILLS: Procedures as agent skills: `/rust-ai-native-sweep` (recurring), `/rust-ai-native-terraform` (brownfield adoption) — `vibe skill install` projects them.
